instructions:
Create one individual SVG goblin illustration for a dark fantasy tactical RPG.
Use the attached goblin_sneak.svg as the visual reference for the entire series.
Preserve its angular vector shading, expressive face, oversized pointed ears,
short wiry proportions, worn leather and moss-green / olive / brown palette.
Change the silhouette, equipment, expression and pose to match the description.
Make each character distinctive while clearly belonging to the same family.
Exactly one full-body character, three-quarter view, centered on a square
transparent canvas with generous margins. Keep ears, feet and weapons visible.
Upper-left lighting. Strong readable silhouette at small card sizes.
Clean editable SVG paths, solid layered shapes, restrained cel shading.
No raster textures, blur, scenery, text, labels, borders or decorative platforms.
